tagline: Point-and-click web scraping — no code needed

listExtractor.title: Extract a List
listExtractor.description: Turn any product listing, job board or table into a spreadsheet
listExtractor.tooltip: Click any repeating element on a page — products, jobs, prices, news — and export a clean spreadsheet or JSON in seconds

textSummarizer.title: Text Summarizer
textSummarizer.description: Instantly summarize any page and ask questions about it with AI
textSummarizer.tooltip: Browse any article, report or docs page — get a concise summary and ask follow-up questions powered by AI

pageExtractor.title: Page Extractor
pageExtractor.description: Paste a URL list and pull the same fields from every page at once
pageExtractor.tooltip: Define your fields once, then CrawlPilot visits each URL automatically — great for lead research, pricing audits and content collection at scale

metadataExtractor.title: Metadata Extractor
metadataExtractor.description: Bulk-collect title, author & full article text from any URL list
metadataExtractor.tooltip: No selectors needed — supply URLs and get back structured data: title, author, publish date, keywords and the full page content in Markdown

imageDownloader.title: Image Downloader
imageDownloader.description: Find and save every image on a page — one click, any site
imageDownloader.tooltip: Preview all images on the current page, pick the ones you need, and batch-download product photos, gallery assets or design references instantly

browserUtilities.title: Browser Utilities
browserUtilities.description: Re-enable right-click & text selection on sites that block them
browserUtilities.tooltip: Unlock copy, paste and right-click menus on sites that restrict them — ideal for copying quotes, URLs and content from protected pages
